issue_context.title: implement reader tenant job
issue_context.body:
Create a reader tenant job on tenant startup.

Epic: CRDB-23575

Jira issue: CRDB-42055

review_comments: do other non-cancellable jobs bubble up an error to the resumer?

Yeah, I'd log this as a warning but probably would not return it since doing so fails the job. If we want to be fancy we could set a RunningStatus with the error too if we then also clean it up on next success.

@dt could you check my reasoning here:

I believe this migration runs _right after_ tenant _creation_ not tenant after _start_. Note that the reader tenant is created in the same txn that the replicating tenant and ingestion job are created here:

https://github.com/msbutler/cockroach/blob/master/pkg/ccl/crosscluster/physical/stream_ingestion_planning.go#L193

So, I think this all means that the replicatedTime returned via `ReadFromTenantInfo` is very likely to be zero (i.e. the initial scan has not completed). If we pass a 0 replicated time to `SetupOrAdvanceStandbyReaderCatalog`, it will blow up.

I think the cleaner logic  here would be to only start the long running job at bootstrap. Then within the job where we poll every 15s, we wait to run `SetupOrAdvanceStandbyReaderCatalog` only once the replicated time has advanced. 

Also, what does it mean to set up a job in a tenant that has been created but not started?
Not quite. This upgrade is run by the tenant when it starts. It isn't started until it has service enabled, which is done by the pcr job after the scan is finished.

That said, I agree with the suggestion that we should avoid calling `SetupOrAdvanceStandbyReaderCatalog` if we see a zero ts, so in the poller job we'd `continue` if it is zero, and in this bootstrap upgrade we'd just log a warning and proceed to only setup the poller job if it was zero.

But I'd still keep the call in the bootstrap, since we run bootstrap before opening up to SQL queries, just to try to avoid having those queries come in before the catalog is setup and race with the poller job.

usually, very little state is stored in the resumer, except `job` and `settings`.

You should be able to access `descs.DB` and the `mtinfo.ReadFromTenantInfoAccessor` via the `execCtx` passed to resume. Let me know if you want help figuring this out.
Good to know! I think I got it
even `settings` I think you can get from the execCtx too.
